meta.description: See what the model actually sees: traceable, editable AI context and memory

items.systemDesc: The assistant's base instructions, plus the rule for tagging each sentence's sources
items.question: Your question

reasons.history_invalid: Left out: not used this time, or a memory it relied on changed
reasons.history_valid: The memory versions it relied on still hold
reasons.relevant: Relevant to this context and question
reasons.summary: Rebuilt only from history that may be used
reasons.near_miss: Relevant, but crowded out by the count or length limit

changes.reading: corrected the reading of the moment

lens.emptyBody: As you type, relevant memories slide into the strip above the input. Once there's an answer, hover any sentence to see where it came from.
examples: Recommend a restaurant for Friday's team dinner
How should I think about transaction isolation levels?
Where should I take friends for dinner on Thursday?
lens.stripIdle: Start typing and relevant memories slide in
lens.stripRemovable: (drag it up or down to leave it out)
lens.proposeScene: Recent turns fit none of your situations. Add “{name}”?
lens.correctTitle: Fix this if it read the moment wrong
lens.degraded: Couldn't read the moment this turn, so your words stand in.
lens.rewriteHint: Rewrite this answer with these changes
lens.situationsBody: Situations are the few broad areas you use this for. Each turn is read against their definitions to find the main one. They only lightly affect what comes to mind, and never wall memories off.
lens.situationsDefinition: What it is for and what it includes
lens.situationsDuplicate: Two situations share a name. Please change one.
lens.situationsAsk: Say how you usually use it
lens.situationsAskHint: For example: mostly revising my thesis and preparing for interviews, sometimes cooking and weekend plans.
lens.situationsFailed: The AI could not suggest anything. Check your model settings and try again.

toast.waitForAnswer: Wait for this answer to finish first
toast.noSource: This sentence has no context behind it; the model inferred it

answer.noBasis: No context behind this; the model inferred it
answer.receipt: Sent {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}} of context · {tokens, number} tokens
answer.stale: {count, plural, one {# item may be} other {# items may be}} out of date

back.usedBy: · used by {count, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}}
back.dirty: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}, rewritten when you flip back

library.title: Memory library
library.actionFailed: Action failed. Refresh and try again.
library.purgeConfirm: This can't be undone. The history will only show that a memory existed.
library.splitName: Tick memories, name the new concept

editor.title: Title
editor.hint: Each save is a new version; older ones stay in the history and can be brought back.
editor.conflict: This memory was just changed elsewhere. Reload and try again.

settings.title: Models
settings.subtitle: Connect a provider, then pick the model next to the input. Keys are saved only on this machine in ~/.contextlens/settings.json (readable by you alone) and never sent back to the browser.

agent.name: Main model
agent.desc: Answers and uses tools. Must support tool calls.

memory.name: Memory upkeep
memory.desc: Distills memories from conversations. A cheaper model is fine.

embedding.name: Vector search
embedding.desc: Turns memories and documents into vectors for retrieval. Runs on this machine by default, with nothing to set up.

settings.advancedNote: Memory upkeep follows the main model by default; vector search uses the local model. If you pick a provider's vector model, your memories are sent to that provider.
settings.apiKeyKeep: Leave empty to keep the saved key
settings.noModelsOfKind: This provider has no model for this role.

picker.more: {count} more models — search, or tick them under “Add or manage models”

memory.inChat: Turn {turn} of a chat · you said
memory.emptyHint: As you chat, every memory the agent saves or changes shows up here, and each one can be undone.
